items.exampleEn: My luggage was lost at the airport.
items.exampleZh: 我的行李在機場弄丟了。

items.exampleEn: The old railway runs along the coast.
items.exampleZh: 那條舊鐵路沿著海岸延伸。

items.exampleEn: The hotel is only a short distance from the beach.
items.exampleZh: 這家飯店離海灘只有一小段距離。

items.exampleEn: Electric vehicles are becoming more popular.
Our guide told us the history of the castle.
items.exampleZh: 導遊向我們介紹了城堡的歷史。

items.exampleEn: Which airline are you flying with?
items.exampleZh: 你搭哪一家航空公司的飛機？

items.exampleEn: We couldn't find any parking near the market.
items.exampleZh: 我們在市場附近找不到任何停車位。

items.exampleEn: The city spends a lot on transportation.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市在交通上花很多錢。

items.sentenceEn: The tour guide speaks four languages.
items.sentenceZh: 這位導遊會說四種語言。

items.audioEn: Parking is not allowed in front of the hotel, but you can park behind the building.
items.audioZh: 飯店前面禁止停車，不過可以停在大樓後面。

items.sentenceEn: This airline offers cheap flights to many cities.
items.sentenceZh: 這家航空公司提供飛往許多城市的便宜機票。

items.sentenceEn: From a distance, the mountain looks like a sleeping dog.
items.sentenceZh: 從遠處看，那座山像一隻睡著的狗。

items.stemEn: Please keep your ____ with you at all times in the station.
items.stemZh: 在車站裡請隨時看好你的行李。

items.stemEn: The city is building a new ____ line between the two towns.
items.stemZh: 市政府正在兩個城鎮之間興建一條新的鐵路線。

items.passageEn: Hilltown is only forty minutes from the city by railway. Trains run every half hour, and the station is near the main crossroads. You can leave your luggage at the station for two dollars. Vehicles are not allowed in the old town center, so please use the parking area outside the walls. Local transportation includes buses and bikes for rent. If you need help, a guide at the tourist office can show you the best places to visit.
items.passageZh: 搭火車從市區到 Hilltown 只要四十分鐘。火車每半小時一班，車站就在主要的十字路口附近。你可以把行李寄放在車站，費用兩元。老城中心禁止車輛進入，所以請使用城牆外的停車區。當地的交通工具有公車和出租腳踏車。如果需要幫忙，遊客服務處的導遊可以告訴你最值得去的地方。

questions.questionZh: 在車站寄放行李要多少錢？

items.promptZh: 你知道從這裡到車站的距離嗎？
referenceEn: Do you know the distance from here to the station?
Do you know the distance between here and the station?
rubricZh: 「從 A 到 B 的距離」可寫，例如 the distance from A to B、the distance between A and B 等
問句注意助動詞與語序

items.instructionZh: 用 transportation 造一個句子，說說你平常使用的交通方式。
referenceEn: My main form of transportation is the bus.
I use public transportation to get to work every day.
rubricZh: transportation 表示「交通、運輸」，是不可數名詞
可用 public transportation、form of transportation 等說法
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
